scope: Follow-up to merchant-page design: original-source data accuracy, customer-readable E-Receipt representation and merchant workspace consolidation. Local application only. Not a complete BIR/accreditation acceptance audit.
user_scope_change: User authorized retiring the redundant merchant Transactions page. Its ledger functionality is now a subview of Invoices&Receipts; no financial records are deleted.

documentation.basis: Read-only original details and history; E-Receipt is customer-readable representation, not a canonical tax record; authoritative amounts, source preservation and controlled access.
Immutable invoice source, separate payments/transmission/evidence, no fabricated screenshot status or sample data.
Business Style optional; invoices and supplementary receipts serve different purposes. This cross-check does not establish current taxpayer coverage or accreditation.
Type-specific invoice/payment examples and input-tax caveat. The screen does not claim approved BIR format or official API wire-code conformance.

controls.behavior: One read-only representation serves merchant details, own records drawer and administrative document preview. Original seller/buyer, tax classification, amounts, line items and dates are preserved. No current profile overwrites historic source values.

Wizard centavos convert to PHP once. Document total, withholding, net payable before settlements, actual recorded settlements and remaining balance are distinct. No fabricated VAT subtraction/addition or double withholding. Equal/zero duplicate totals are omitted from the printed copy; differing recorded balances remain visible and inconsistencies are warned.

Optional Business Style is omitted unless recorded. The NUERS account label, VAT registration, current business name or address are not substitutes. Unknown payment method, branch, buyer TIN/address or permit remains unrecorded. Missing lines/quantities/units are not invented; a derived quantity-times-unit-price amount is explicitly identified.

VAT-exempt example1000PHP retains0VAT and1000VAT-exempt sales. Primary invoice type is independent of the backing receipt table. Exact registration labels parse to a boolean; Non-VAT strings are never treated as truthy VAT registration. Initial and additional wizard lines respect VAT/non-VAT/exempt/zero-rated selection.

Unsaved/local-checked previews remain drafts; edits invalidate local checks. Saved source state and BIR evidence remain separate. No generic QR glyph, record number or checksum is represented as a working public-token verification QR. No BIR approval, accreditation or issuance authorization is inferred from rendering.

Read-only original details show actual latest30 lifecycle events and recorded actors; inferred versions/events are removed. Buttons that only simulated sending/marking paid are disabled; original changes use the reviewed correction workflow.

PDF download refreshes the authenticated original, records render authorization with actor/role/tenant/correlation and renders the same source representation. Page splitting keeps ordinary rows and footer sections whole; the inspected sample is one A4page with intact typography, amounts and footer.

The separate merchant Transactions page and navigation entries are removed. Old bookmarks redirect with query parameters to Payment Activity inside Invoices&Receipts. Financial/payment/integration records and APIs are preserved; document and payment amounts are not merged into extra sales.

Source lines, linked payment metadata and lifecycle events are separately scoped to the original merchant. Financial reconciliation also excludes foreign child items. Existing role/device/MFA ownership boundary remains in place.
